miniaudio (https://miniaud.io) by David Reid.

miniaudio is not vendored in this repository. The release build fetches miniaudio.h
(version recorded in tools/audio/SOURCES, checked by sha256) and builds mfl_audio_miniaudio.dll from it.

miniaudio is dual-licensed; you may choose either of:
  - Public domain (Unlicense, https://unlicense.org)
  - MIT No Attribution (MIT-0)

The full license texts are at the end of miniaudio.h.
